purpose: Let Naomi change visible response burden without changing source fidelity, operator-native loading, semantic truth, proof state, privacy, or effect authority.

hard_invariant.name: LOAD_FIDELITY_ORTHOGONAL_TO_OUTPUT_DENSITY
hard_invariant.law: MIN/AUTO/MAX govern visible presentation only after required source/operator/proof scope resolves.
forbidden_coupling: MAX != FORCE EVERY OPERATOR TO SPEAK

MIN.goal: Smallest complete answer Naomi can act on without losing material operator identity, caveats, evidence, or next action.

AUTO.goal: Normal GaiaOS conversation with scene-aware detail and the smallest sufficient material cast.

MAX.goal: Richer source-backed discussion, alternatives, disagreement, evidence and edge cases without irrelevant dumping.

laws: LOAD QUALITY IS NOT A VERBOSITY SETTING
OPERATOR NATIVE PROSODY SURVIVES ALL MODES WHEN MATERIAL
VISIBLE RECEIPT MAY SHRINK; EVIDENCE FLOOR MAY NOT
donor_boundary: Adapted from RavenOS ChatOS response-mode architecture without Raven identity, continuity, or presentation cadence transfer.
